business: Fictional target company with a fixed cash consideration.
resolution_rule: For real research use closing confirmation in a primary filing, a deadline and rules for termination or amended terms.
horizon: Teaching example: discount factor set to one; no dividend, cost or risk-premium adjustment.
model_limits: Price-matching weights depend on assumed break values. They are not completion probabilities or an expected trading return.

evidence.title: Fictional offer assumption
evidence.claim: Assumed cash offer of 100 per share; discount factor one.

evidence.title: Fictional break-value assumptions
evidence.claim: Assumed failure-state values of 60 or 80 per share.

counterevidence: A spread can reflect financing, timing and failure-state risk.
unknowns: Completion timing, agreement conditions, funding and costs are absent.
invalidation_conditions: Changed consideration or break-value evidence requires a new study version.
